gifts.name: Festival Foundation
gifts.tagline: Insurance, permits, lions, and infrastructure every festival needs.
gifts.description: CGL insurance, CCSD permit + TFF coordinator, lion dances (Sat + Sun), transport and traffic, ops tents, organic digital marketing, volunteer meals, and festival coordination — embedded in the MVP cap.
benefits: Foundation sponsor recognition on website + email

gifts.name: Main Stage
gifts.tagline: 40×60 canopy over wide dance floor + LED — sun shelter for crews; gear cover for sun/rain teardown (rain day still cancels).
gifts.description: Festival **main stage** under a **~40×60 frame canopy/tent** with a **wide dance floor** (Moditional / spirit cast — **not** a narrow APEX trailer stage that forced crews onto open ground). Canopy jobs: (1) **shelter dancers from sun**, (2) **protect LED + PA from sun and rain**, (3) buy time for **orderly teardown** if weather turns — rain still **cancels the festival day** (we are **not** renting a guest rain hall or planning a wet show). Includes dance deck as needed, ADA, **changing-room trailer(s)**, stay-put **LED** + lights, PA, generators. LED doubles as **Saturday Spirit Charge / Fashion backdrop** and **Sunday Tailgate watch** surface. Big Game **broadcast rights** stay a separate Tailgate gift. Confirm 40×60 + trailer quotes.
benefits: Main stage sponsor recognition on website + digital sponsor slide

lineItems.label: 40×60 canopy/tent + weights/safety — dance floor + LED/PA sun·rain gear cover (not audience rain hall; rain day still cancels)
Stage / dance deck under tent (as needed)
Changing-room trailer(s) — performers / Moditional / Spirit cast
LED wall + stage lights (Sat Charge · Sun Tailgate watch)

gifts.name: Safe Festival
gifts.tagline: Private security — peak grounds, traffic/parking direction, and overnight site/stage cover.
gifts.description: One private-security contractor, three posts: (1) peak festival-grounds crowd safety, (2) traffic and parking direction at entries and crossings, and (3) **overnight Sat→Sun** to cover main stage and site assets — required whether or not Tailgate camps stake overnight. Daytime hours remap with dusk Sat / Tailgate as product locks.
benefits: Safety sponsor recognition on website + email

gifts.name: Festival Amenities
gifts.tagline: Restrooms, hand-wash, and pro trash crew — volunteers handle simple litter.
gifts.description: Restrooms and hand-wash stations for the weekend, plus hired porters and trash collectors for heavy and gross waste. Volunteer crews pick up simple litter only — not bins, kitchens, or restrooms.
benefits: Named amenity sponsor on website + digital sponsor slide

gifts.name: Walking Procession (charge the circle)
gifts.tagline: Obon-style walking circle at the Pavilion — charge good energy; no motor parade.
gifts.description: Paid parade performers and hired units, plus parade production polish: route staging, lineup and spacing, MC/cue coordination, and unit check-in — the ops that turn hired performers into a coherent parade. Without Parade+, there is no parade at MVP.

gifts.name: Decor
gifts.tagline: Lanterns, stage flowers, and site accents — visual Tết atmosphere across the park.
gifts.description: Site decor registry block: lanterns, pole and entrance accents, stage flowers, and install labor — what families photograph on the grounds. Parade route production lives under Parade Performers.
benefits: Logo on decor assets photographed for social

gifts.name: Spread the Word
gifts.tagline: Spread the Word presented by [Sponsor] — reach families who have not found us yet.
gifts.description: Paid Facebook/Instagram and boosted posts — media sponsorship, not a petty-cash ask. No print posters.

gifts.name: Honor our Elders
gifts.tagline: Shade tents, seating, and tea — a rest zone for grandparents.
gifts.description: Named elder rest zone with shade, seating, and tea service. Not in MVP ops — grass fallback without sponsor.

gifts.name: Cây nêu (Tết Pole)
gifts.tagline: Traditional centerpiece — the pole families gather around at Tết.
gifts.description: Traditional Tết pole centerpiece. 2027 community pool pilot — materials, decor labor, and volunteer meals.
benefits: Named on website + Facebook/Instagram unlock post

gifts.name: Spirit Charge
gifts.tagline: Dusk hunt finale — e-pop, lions vs spirits, audience glow, VJ on the LED. Not a late-night concert.
gifts.description: **Spirit Charge** — Saturday **dusk hunt finale**, remapped from the old Saturday Night Headliner. Funds hunt-timed music/AV cues, dusk program crew, MC, **audience glow sticks**, and a **VJ** who builds and cues **Charge LED animations** on the main-stage wall (ball fight · drop · win beats) — the LED hardware is already in festival **Main Stage core**. Content is **human-directed** live motion graphics / mapped clips — **not** generative-AI filler. Not a 5–8 PM concert stack. Listed **$9,500** pending music/AV, stick, and VJ quotes.
benefits: Sponsor credit on Charge chapter posts + dusk program cue

lineItems.label: Hunt music / electronic-pop + AV cue package
Dusk Charge program crew (daylight → finale handoff)
Audience glow sticks — bulk pack + dusk distribute
VJ — Charge LED animation pack + live cue (human-made)

gifts.name: Paris By Night Style Revue
gifts.tagline: ~2-hour produced variety show — singers, comedy, cultural numbers, MC.
gifts.description: Talent booking for a signature PBN-style revue on the MVP stage — singers, comedy, cultural acts, and MC. Assumes baseline stage, PA, and sound engineers; add Covered Main Stage for upgraded sound, lights, LED, and weather tent.

gifts.name: Lucky Wav Edition
gifts.tagline: Younger-skewed stage block — DJs, R&B, rap, dance.
gifts.description: Named Lucky Wav stage segment — one selectable programming block among PBN revue, Sat night headliner, and other talent sponsors.

gifts.name: Asian Cajun Show
gifts.tagline: ~2–3 hour programming block — Gulf Coast bands, fusion acts, and MC.
gifts.description: Booked Asian Cajun / Louisiana lineup on the MVP indoor or outdoor stage — existing PA and sound engineers are in core ops. Zydeco, R&B, and fusion acts for a 2–3 hour show block, like the programming families gathered around at Asian Cajun Village in 2026.

gifts.name: Children's Show
gifts.tagline: Kids stage — short sets parents can actually sit through.
gifts.description: Sac County Fair Kids Zone model — **30–45 min blocks, 2–3 sets per day** on the family stage (local magic, storytelling, puppetry, character participation). Participation beats spectacle; not a headliner stack. Assumes baseline stage, PA, and sound engineers in core ops. Pair with **Children's Village** (in-ground activities + anchor hosts), **Moditional Dance Battle** (HS fusion crew battle — see `moditional_dance_battle`), and **Tết Relay Cup** (open-age relay bracket — see `tet_relay_cup`).

lineItems.label: Magic sets ×2 (45 min each — local fair acts)

gifts.name: Meme Dance Contest
gifts.tagline: A drop-in dance challenge — a high schooler leads from the stage, kids follow on the floor.
gifts.description: Short, low-pressure dance heats built around current, family-safe songs and choreography kids recognize from their feeds. A high school dance-crew leader teaches the moves from the stage while kids follow along on the floor — no experience needed, just jump in — then heats let anyone who wants the spotlight compete. A DJ and host keep the energy up, the crowd cheers, and small prizes keep it playful. Includes a public-performance licensing allowance; final music coverage must be confirmed against the selected songs before the event.

lineItems.label: Dance floor markings, signage + check-in supplies

gifts.name: Moditional Dance Battle
gifts.tagline: Modern-meets-traditional crew battle — schools remix áo dài, lion, and fan with hip-hop and K-pop.
gifts.description: **Moditional Dance Battle** — a **judged, cross-school modern + traditional fusion crew competition**. **EGUSD high school** crews and cultural clubs compete head-to-head, but every routine must **fuse modern + traditional** (áo dài, lion, fan, or heritage movement remixed with hip-hop / K-pop / cover). Scoring blends a **light panel** with a **crowd-hype meter**, so the audience has a job. **Participation guardrail:** between rounds, a near-peer leader runs an **open-floor learn-along** (shared with the Meme Dance Contest mechanic) so little kids and families jump in — not a watch-only stage. **Medals + traveling title to crews, no individual crowning** — celebrates craft, not a pageant pedestal. **Pan-APIDA / multicultural** — open to all school clubs, not VN-only. Battle crews also supply the near-peer leaders for the Meme Dance Contest. **Separate from Tết Relay Cup** (grass athletics) and the **Meme Dance Contest** (under-12 follow-along). College / campus orgs route to **Sac State APIDA LNY**. *(Successor to the 2026 Youth Culture Day stage showcase.)*
benefits: Facebook/Instagram feature + school tags on the bracket grid
MC thank-you for participating schools + crew photo-op

lineItems.label: Crew prize pool + traveling title / medals
DJ + hype MC/host (battle energy + open-floor learn-along calls)
Public-performance music licensing allowance (confirm vs final tracks)
Open participation floor, crew staging, bracket signage + program

gifts.name: Tết Relay Cup
gifts.tagline: Open-age relay bracket — clubs, leagues, and community teams on the grass.
gifts.description: **Tết Relay Cup** — festival-run **relay tournament** on the grass corral beside Children's Village. **Not a youth-only product** — open **age brackets** (adult rec, parish teams, school clubs, service orgs). **2027 MVP:** one featured bracket (often HS-heavy); expand divisions as registration fills. Single-elimination heats, East/West or age pools, prizes to winning teams. **Moditional Dance Battle** (stage) is a **separate registry block** — schools may do both. College org performance routes to Sac State APIDA LNY.
benefits: Facebook/Instagram feature + public bracket on website program
MC thank-you for participating schools and clubs
Traveling trophy + prize checks to winning club accounts

lineItems.label: Prize pool — champion, runner-up, division split, spirit
Relay facilitator + East/West bracket ops + corral supplies

gifts.name: Children's Village
gifts.tagline: Shade, activities, anchor hosts — families regroup and kids do Tết.
gifts.description: **Family home base** — compact zone with shade, stroller corral, benches, and cultural **do** stations (lantern craft, red-envelope play, scavenger). **Anchor hosts** run repeat parent–toddler sessions (bilingual sing-along, story circle — a person families already know, not an empty org tent). **Turnkey activations** for gyms/PTAs: partner forwards one email; festival runs the slot. **Family meetup corral** with labeled stations on the map. Adjacent to Tết Relay Cup corral. **Bounce house rentals** (vendor) and **owned inflatable carnival games** (deploy labor) are **separate registry blocks** — same **Children's Village** director when funded. Not in MVP ops.
benefits: Named on activity signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Family meetup corral — signage, map pin, labeled stations
Anchor host sessions (2 curated hosts × weekend stipends)

gifts.name: Bounce House Rentals
gifts.tagline: Rented bounce houses — vendor delivers, sets up, and hauls away.
gifts.description: **Vendor rental only** — not the coalition-owned inflatable carnival games in storage. Party-rental company delivers bounce houses for the weekend, handles setup/teardown and cleaning, and takes them back. **Children's Village** director books the vendor and zone layout; **Foundation** director confirms **CGL covers inflatables** (or rider increment below) and collects **vendor COI** naming the coalition before go. Bounce houses typically **change insurance requirements** — do not unlock without Foundation sign-off.
benefits: Named on play-zone signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Bounce house rentals ×2 (weekend — delivery, setup, teardown, vendor clean)
Safety mats / perimeter if not in rental
CGL review / rider increment for inflatables (Foundation confirms quote)

gifts.name: Inflatable Carnival Games
gifts.tagline: Our 8-station carnival games — deploy + wind weights (2026 lesson).
gifts.description: cPALSs + VACOS **already own** the Magic Jump–class **8-station inflatable games** bundle ([product reference](https://www.magicjump.com/blog/inflatable-carnival-games/)). This block pays **deploy cost only** — U-Haul trailer, setup/teardown crew, cleaning, **weighted ballast** (blocks/barrels) to **secure against wind** — **2026 gap:** games were not weighted enough — plus **6K portable generator + weekend fuel**, and **storage amortization**. **Not** bounce houses (separate rental block). **Children's Village** director runs the zone; do not open stations without ballast per manufacturer / park wind rules.
benefits: Named on game-station signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Setup + teardown labor (hired hands or volunteer crew meals)

Weighted ballast blocks / barrels — wind secure (2026 gap)

gifts.name: Fashion Garden
gifts.tagline: An all-weekend heritage-fashion garden — dress up, promenade, and take the family photo.
gifts.description: Replaces the competitive pageant with an open, family-facing fashion experience in the Pavilion: styled garden photo sets, áo dài ambassadors, public dress-up participation, rotating lighthearted contests, and a walking parade corps. Composed with Viet Cafe so parents can linger while families rotate through the sets. No crowning, interviews, dedicated stage, or booked show stack.
benefits: Naming credit on photo-set and Pavilion signage

lineItems.label: Áo dài ambassador stipends + call time

gifts.name: Viet Cafe
gifts.tagline: Pavilion cafe — tables, charging, warm lighting. Exclusive beverage vendor pays their own setup.
gifts.description: An all-day parent-respite cafe composed with Fashion Garden in the Pavilion. An exclusive beverage vendor sells Vietnamese coffee, boba, and family drinks — **exclusivity is their benefit; this gift does not subsidize vendor setup.** Gift funds the shared environment: comfortable seating (prefer CCSD Pavilion tables/chairs in-kind where possible), charging, warm lighting, and decor. The cafe is the function; Fashion Garden is the photo-rich setting.
benefits: Naming credit on cafe and charging-area signage

lineItems.label: Cafe tables + seating + family regroup area
Safe guest charging stations + power distribution
Warm lighting, menu boards + cafe decor

gifts.name: Community Yearbook Photo Set
gifts.tagline: One annual whole-community portrait — free, open, and built for the archive.
gifts.description: A scheduled all-community group portrait at the festival — the rare open gathering where families, organizations, and generations can appear in one frame. Funds a professional photographer, wide backdrop / group markers, an elevated camera position subject to CCSD approval, and crowd coordination. Delivers a high-resolution annual artifact for families, archives, sponsor decks, and grant reach reporting. Distinct from Fashion Garden's individual photo sets and áo dài corps portrait.
benefits: Sponsor credit with the published annual portrait

lineItems.label: Wide backdrop, group markers + photo signage
Timed gather, crowd coordination + accessibility support

gifts.name: Spirit Design — First Set
gifts.tagline: Hire human artists for the first festival-owned spirit cast — silhouettes, color keys, and shareable key art. No AI-generated art.
gifts.description: Commissions the **first festival-owned spirit set** from **hired human artists** for Linhhonology soft myth — the lookbook kids “collect” and marketing shows before anyone meets a body on the grass. Pays art direction plus character commissions for **about 4–6 spirits** (epithets, silhouettes / color keys, key art) and crop packs for host cards, web, social, Children’s Village crafts, and Spirit Charge promotion. **Artistic integrity lock:** deliverables must be **human-made** (drawn / painted / designed by people under contract). **No generative-AI image tools** for final spirit art, key art, or published crops — audience trust and brand integrity depend on it. Festival retains assignment / work-for-hire rights for Elk Grove Tết and stewarded peer-festival reuse. **Not** day-of costume performers — that is **Spirit Actors & Forms**. Working dollars pending real quotes; later seasons can open community contribution under the same style keys and the same no-AI rule.
benefits: Spirit Design — First Set presented by [Sponsor]
Sponsor credit on spirit reveal cards + web feature
Named on first-release spirit art posts

lineItems.label: Human art direction / style keys for first set
Human artist commissions — 4–6 spirits (sheets + key poses)
Marketing crops — host cards, web, social packs

gifts.name: Spirit Actors & Forms
gifts.tagline: Live spirit meet-and-greets — festival forms kids can pose with after the art set exists.
gifts.description: Day-of **Spirit Actors & Forms**: 2–4 hired performers (or costumed hosts) for scheduled meet-and-greet and photo windows in festival-owned spirit looks. **Recognition is the product** — kids arrive wanting a form they already saw on cards and feeds. Pulls costume / silhouette direction from **Spirit Design — First Set** when that gift is funded; without design art, stay silhouette-simple and festival-original (no trademarked characters, no studio names). Different from Fashion Garden (real guests and áo dài ambassadors). Dedicated photo-line role so performers stay presentable and the line keeps moving.
benefits: Sponsor credit on spirit meet schedule + photo-line signage

lineItems.label: Spirit performers — 2–4 rotating meet windows (pending quotes)
Costume / form finish aligned to design set (or silhouette MVP)

gifts.tagline: Commercial / public-exhibition rights + legal feed — fund before any Tailgate watch gift.
gifts.description: **Broadcast / exhibition rights first.** Pays the commercial or public-exhibition streaming/cable license and legal feed so the festival may show Super Bowl Sunday on-site. **Go/no-go if rights cannot be secured.** Does **not** include LED (already in Main Stage core) or Main-Stage Watch kickoff peak security. Fund this before **Main-Stage Watch** or optional Kloss camp screen — those gifts assume rights are clear.
benefits: Named Big Game rights sponsor on website + digital sponsor slide

lineItems.label: Commercial / public-exhibition streaming license + legal feed

gifts.tagline: Kickoff peak security/traffic add when the crowd gathers at the main-stage screen — grass is the seat.
gifts.description: Sunday Tailgate **watch on the Main Stage LED** (LED already in festival core). **Requires Big Game — Core (Licensing).** This gift is only a **Tailgate kickoff peak security / traffic soft add** when the crowd gathers at the outdoor stage — not a seating, heater, wayfinding, or hospitality package. Guests find the big screen and sit on the grass (or bring what they bring). **No indoor Pavilion LED.** Optional Kloss camp screen is separate and also needs Core licensing.
benefits: Big Game — Main-Stage Watch presented by [Sponsor]
Named on Tailgate kickoff / watch chapter recognition

gifts.description: Optional outdoor LED **inside Kloss** for Tailgate camps. **Requires Big Game — Core (Licensing)** — rights are not in this gift. Only if camps stay watching in Kloss; otherwise gather at main stage. Funds **camp screen package** and **Sunday security extension** for that gather — no heaters, seating, or hospitality package. Camps bring their own chairs.

MC thank-you + website / Facebook / Instagram feature

gifts.name: Sponsor booth spot
gifts.tagline: On-site sponsor activation — bring your own tent.
gifts.description: 10×10 sponsor activation footprint at the festival (not a vendor booth application). You provide the tent; cPALSs assigns your on-site location and recognizes you on the website.

gifts.name: Premium Tent Rental
gifts.tagline: Optional — we rent the 10×10 for your sponsor booth.
gifts.description: Capitol Tent City 10×10 tent + weights for Sat–Sun festival. Add alongside sponsor booth spot if you prefer not to bring your own tent.
benefits: Delivery + pickup handled by festival ops
Same 10×10 spec as sponsor booth footprint

gifts.name: Influencer Meet & Greet
gifts.tagline: Creator tent / micro-stage meet & greet + collab posts — not a main-stage revue.
gifts.description: Books a **regional creator young people already follow** (Raina / LovelyMimi tier) for a **scheduled meet & greet with a photo line** at a **sponsor tent or micro-stage pad** (not a main-stage revue block), plus **collaboration posts** that carry the festival into feeds beyond word of mouth. **2026 proof:** LovelyMimi and Raina brought out a substantial young audience, especially **high schoolers**. The lesson is **creator fit matters** — not that influencers lack draw. For 2027, make that draw legible and usable: announce a fixed appearance window, capture the creator-attributed audience, and convert recognition into a meet-and-greet photo moment. **Dual-purpose spend:** part programming, part **marketing** — the collab posts are paid reach we would otherwise buy. **Pricing is a placeholder:** this tier can retail near **$10K**; **$5,000** is our working number pending real quotes, and the ask scales with the creator. Staff the **photo line separately from any brief micro-set** so the line keeps moving.

lineItems.label: Creator fee — appearance + meet & greet window (placeholder; scales with tier)
Photo-line staffing, backdrop, queue management + signage

gifts.name: Community Heritage Performance Showcase
gifts.tagline: Community traditions take the stage — hula, folklórico, folk dance, taiko, and more.
gifts.description: A curated, **noncompetitive community heritage showcase** featuring short performance sets from traditions represented across the region — for example, **hālau hula, Mexican folklórico, Filipino folk dance, taiko, and other community ensembles**. This is a welcome-and-share stage block: **no judges, rankings, brackets, prizes, or winner language**. Modest group honoraria recognize preparation and travel; a producer curates a balanced run-of-show and clean stage handoffs. Assumes the baseline stage, PA, and sound engineer are already funded through core ops. Unlike the **Moditional Dance Battle**, this gift does not turn heritage performance into a contest; unlike the **Vietnamese Heritage Fund**, it supports broad community representation within the family fair.
benefits: Community Heritage Performance Showcase presented by [Sponsor]
Sponsor credit on the showcase schedule and stage signage
Website + Facebook/Instagram feature tagging participating groups

lineItems.label: Community ensemble honoraria — curated mix of groups
